question: Will Ethereum be above $1,800 on Binance at 7:59 PM UTC+2 on August 31, 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the ETH/USDT spot price on Binance is strictly above $1,800 USDT at 17:59 UTC on August 31, 2026 (equivalent to 7:59 PM GMT+2).
- "No": Wins if the ETH/USDT spot price on Binance is at or below $1,800 USDT at 17:59 UTC on August 31, 2026 (equivalent to 7:59 PM GMT+2).
